items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Something like on the order of Tex Beneke.

ctx.x: Office during the war-time. Got a job in the Post Office. He had a family, you know. So he quit playing. He was a good player all right, but he wasn't no Lester Young! I remember Julius, the one I just got through talking about... Paul's tone was kind of raggedy. I don't know, looked like he was strainin' to blow. You know what I mean? He wasn't smooth. But he could play. Something like on the order of Tex Beneke.
So he played. He pulled his horn out and he started blowing. He started. Then Page come up and brought his bass. Paul started playing before Page got up there, then Page started playing the bass.
